Campus & facilities

Campus & Infrastructure

Lecture halls, laboratories, library, teaching hospital and student amenities, all in one place.

Campus Life

Campus GuideLibrary & FacilitiesCampus & InfrastructureStudent & Hostel GuidePhoto GalleryNotices & EventsMedCampusOS Portal

SVS Medical College and the SVS Teaching Hospital share one campus at Yenugonda, Mahabubnagar, with 1,41,440 square metres of built-up space for teaching, clinical work and student life. Everything below is on that campus or in the college’s community health centres.

Academic & learningCentral libraryTeaching hospitalHostels & amenities

Academic & learning infrastructure

Lecture theatres
Four gallery-type, air-conditioned lecture halls in the college block seat 350 students each, and two gallery-type lecture halls in the hospital block seat 200 each. Every hall has interactive smart panels, projectors and high-speed internet.
Skills laboratory
A 1,000-square-metre skills laboratory with 16 specialised training halls. High-fidelity mannequins, procedural task trainers, video recording, debriefing areas and individual and group skill stations let students practise clinical skills before they see patients.
Practical laboratories & museums
Fully equipped laboratories for histology, clinical physiology, biochemistry, histopathology, haematology, microbiology, clinical pharmacology and computer-assisted learning (CAL). Seven departmental museums hold mounted specimens, models, bone sets and radiological archives.
Examination halls
Two centrally air-conditioned, video-monitored examination halls, seating 250 and 200.

Central library & learning resource centre

Area & seating
Fully air-conditioned and spread over 3,541 square metres, with more than 500 seats: two undergraduate reading halls of 250 seats each, a separate postgraduate reading hall and a faculty study lounge.
Collections & digital library
More than 17,204 medical textbooks and reference volumes, 99 national and international print journals, and a digital library with 40 high-speed internet nodes for international databases.
Timings
9:00 AM to 10:00 PM on all working days.

SVS Teaching Hospital & clinical training

Beds & patients
1,043 teaching beds on the same campus, more than 2,300 outpatients a day and bed occupancy above 85%, so students see a wide range of patients at the bedside.
Emergency & critical care
A 30-bed, 24-hour emergency and casualty wing with dedicated triage, disaster-management and resuscitation areas. 100 intensive-care beds across the MICU, SICU, ICCU, RICU, NICU, PICU, obstetric HDU/ICU and burns ICU, plus a 20-bed dialysis unit.
Operating theatres
23 operating suites (14 major and 9 minor) with modern anaesthesia workstations and multiparameter monitors.
Diagnostics
Philips 3.0 Tesla wide-bore MRI, Siemens 128-slice CT, 15 high-resolution ultrasound and Doppler stations, cath lab/DSA suites, digital mammography, an NABL-accredited molecular virology laboratory and a licensed 24-hour blood bank with component separation.
Cath lab & cardiac surgery
A flat-panel cath lab and DSA suite run around the clock alongside modular surgical theatres and a dedicated ICCU, supporting emergency angioplasty, coronary interventions and cardiac surgery.
Bone density scanning
Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DEXA) for bone mineral density assessment, helping with early diagnosis of osteoporosis and fracture-risk evaluation.
Robotic knee & hip replacement
The orthopaedic centre uses robotic-arm surgical systems for precise implant placement in total knee and hip replacements.
Neurosurgery, urology & surgical oncology
Dedicated infrastructure and equipment for neurosurgery, urology and surgical oncology.
Community health centres
Field training at the Rural Health Training Centre (RHTC) in Marikal and the Urban Health Training Centre (UHTC) in Newtown.

Residential & student amenities

Hostels
Fully furnished on-campus hostels for undergraduate boys (566 places) and girls (492 places), in double rooms, with continuous water and power supply, laundry and round-the-clock security.
Dining
Five messes and cafeterias across the campus.
Sports & recreation
Outdoor grounds for cricket, football and basketball, an indoor sports complex for badminton and table tennis, a gymnasium, yoga halls and student common rooms of 250 square metres each.
